nature_language: 当前位置北京。我们两个人计划去上海玩两天，开一间双床房，预算5000元，市内交通主要使用地铁。请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Beijing. Two of us are planning to visit Shanghai for two days. We will book a twin room with a budget of 5000 RMB, and mainly use the subway for transportation within the city. Please provide me with a travel plan.
